description: This file defines the ConfigTranslationDeleteForm class, which builds and handles a form for deleting configuration translations in a Drupal module.

classes.name: ConfigTranslationDeleteForm
classes.description: A form class for deleting configuration translations in Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the form with language manager, config mapper manager, and module handler.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the form with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: getQuestion
methods.description: Returns the confirmation question asking if the user wants to delete the translation.

methods.name: getConfirmText
methods.description: Returns the text for the confirmation button.

methods.name: getCancelUrl
methods.description: Provides the URL to redirect to if the deletion is canceled.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the form, populating the mapper and language based on route parameters.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles form submission, deletes language overrides, flushes caches, and shows a status message.
